why.zh: 从两组分工开始，理解为什么不能只追求更小的割代价。用同一张五节点图解释 cut、人数与面积，再认识初始构造、KL/FM、谱二分和多路划分。看完后，你会知道从哪一章开始，以及在实验中应该检查什么。
why.en: Start with a two-team assignment and see why a small cut alone is not enough. A shared five-vertex graph introduces cut cost, counts and areas, followed by construction, KL/FM, spectral and k-way methods. Learn where to begin and what to inspect in the labs.

music.source: Original procedural score; no third-party recording

captions.zh: 一个项目，需要两个小组协作。
captions.en: A project needs two collaborating teams.

captions.zh: 联系紧密的任务，最好留在一起。
captions.en: Keep closely linked tasks together.

captions.zh: 全放一组，跨组沟通可以为零。
captions.en: One part can have zero crossings.

captions.zh: 但空间与工作量，不允许这样分。
captions.en: Space and workload can forbid that assignment.

captions.zh: Partitioning：在约束下划分。
captions.en: Partitioning means dividing under constraints.

captions.zh: 芯片单元彼此连线，也需要分区。
captions.en: Connected circuit cells also need regions.

captions.zh: 跨区域连接，是这里衡量的代价。
captions.en: Cross-region connections contribute to our cost.

captions.zh: 先用五个节点，把代价算清楚。
captions.en: Use five vertices to make the cost explicit.

captions.zh: 边权表示切开这条连接的代价。
captions.en: An edge weight is the cost of cutting that connection.

captions.zh: 跨组边的权重，逐条相加。
captions.en: Add the crossing edge weights, one by one.

captions.zh: 总和为12，每条无向边只算一次。
captions.en: The sum is 12. Count each undirected edge once.

captions.zh: 换成 ABC | DE，代价会怎样？
captions.en: Try ABC | DE. What happens to the cut?

captions.zh: cut 为 3，人数仍是二与三。
captions.en: The cut is 3; the counts are still two and three.

captions.zh: 人数平衡，不等于面积可行。
captions.en: Balanced counts do not guarantee feasible areas.

captions.zh: A 面积变为 4，ABC 面积变为 6。
captions.en: Set A's area to 4: ABC then has area 6.

captions.zh: 五个节点，有十五种非空二分。
captions.en: Five vertices have 15 nonempty, unlabeled splits.

captions.zh: 若限定二与三，则剩十种。
captions.en: Requiring counts two and three leaves ten.

captions.zh: 一百个节点，候选已是三十位数。
captions.en: At 100 vertices, the count already has 30 digits.

captions.zh: 逐一试遍，很快就不再现实。
captions.en: Trying every split soon becomes impractical.

captions.zh: 先构造起点：随机、贪心、生长。
captions.en: Construct a start: random, greedy, or growing.

captions.zh: 生长吸收 B，得到 cut 5。
captions.en: Growing adds B, producing cut 5.

captions.zh: KL 成对交换，FM 单点移动。
captions.en: KL exchanges a pair; FM moves one vertex.

captions.zh: 先试探、锁定，再选最佳前缀。
captions.en: Try, lock, then keep the best prefix.

captions.zh: 谱方法用矩阵结构，给节点排序。
captions.en: Spectral structure orders the vertices.

captions.zh: 扫描合法切口，选择较小的 cut。
captions.en: Sweep legal thresholds for a smaller cut.

captions.zh: 继续二分，就能得到更多分组。
captions.en: Repeated bisection produces more parts.

captions.zh: 每次在当前子图上重新计算。
captions.en: Each split solves its current induced subgraph.

captions.zh: 同一张图，比较不同多路方法。
captions.en: Compare k-way methods on the same graph.

captions.zh: 先检查容量，再比较 cut。
captions.en: Check capacity before comparing cut.

captions.zh: 从割代价开始，用实验和代码检验判断。
captions.en: Start with cut cost. Test your reasoning with labs and code.
